Note box (exam pattern) then Prescribed Ragas and Units 1-11; box title repeats the paper title and is not a row

nodes.title: Note

nodes.label: i
nodes.title: The Question Paper will have 75 questions.

nodes.label: ii
nodes.title: All questions will be based on Subject-Specific Knowledge.

nodes.label: iii
nodes.title: All questions are compulsory.

nodes.label: iv
nodes.title: The Questions will be Bilingual (English/Hindi).
Prescribed Ragas
nodes.body: Shankarabharanam, Mohanam, Bilahari, Kharaharapriya, Pantuvarali, Kalyani, Kedaragowla, Keeravani, Anandabhairavi. Arabhi, Vasantha, Abhogi, Hamsadhvani, Shanmukhapriya, Purvikalyani, Simhendra madhyamam, Kanada, Sudha Saveri, Bhairavi, Saveri, Kambhoji, Madhyamavati, Suddhadhanyasi, Purvikalyani, Todi, Dhanyasi, Goula, Varali, Natakuranji, Hindolam, Darbar, Chenjurutti, Malayamarutam, Atana, Sourashtram, Devagandhari, Surati, Sahana, Nilambari, Asaveri, Nadanamakriya, Mayamalavagoula, Valaji, Poornachandrika, Yadukulakamboji, Revagupti.

nodes.title: Definition and brief explanation of:-

nodes.label: a
nodes.title: Nada – Ahata and Anahata Nada, Varieties in Ahata Nada

nodes.label: b
nodes.title: Sruti – Nyuna, Pramana & Purnasruti

nodes.label: c
nodes.title: Swara – Prakriti and Vikriti swaras, swarasthanas,

nodes.label: d
nodes.title: Vadi, Samvadi, Anuvadi, Vivadi

nodes.label: e
nodes.title: Tala, Laya, Kalapramana
Theoretical and comparative knowledge of prescribed ragas and talas:-

nodes.label: a
nodes.title: Raga classification – Janaka, Janya system, scheme of 72 melakarta, Varja & Vakra, Bhashanga, Upanga, Panchamantya, Daivatantya, Nishadantya.

nodes.label: b
nodes.title: Scheme of 35 talas, Suladi Sapta Talas, Chaputala and its varieties, Shadangas, Desadi and Madhyadi talas.
Knowledge of Notation.
Classification of musical instruments in general and Construction, tuning and playing techniques of Tambura, Vina, Violin and Mridangam.
Gamakas:–
nodes.body: Panchadasa and Dasavidha gamakas, Alankaras and its varieties, Kaku and its varieties.

nodes.title: Physics of Sound:-
nodes.body: Explanation of Melody, Polyphony, Harmony, Acoustics, Pitch, Intensity, Timbre.

nodes.title: Patronage of Music:-
nodes.body: Kings, Chieftains, Zamindars, Sabhas, Mass media, Govt. & Corporate

nodes.title: Raga Classification from Ancient, medieval to modern times.
Musical forms figuring in Abhyasa gana and Sabha gana:-
nodes.body: Geetam, Swarajati, Varnam, Kriti, Kirtana, Padam, Javali, Tillana, Ragam-Tanam-Pallavi.

nodes.title: Detailed study of Kalpita Sangeeta and branches of Manodharma Sangita, Folk music.
Knowledge of ancient Tamil Music:-
Lakshana Granthas:-
nodes.body: Natyasastra, Brihaddesi, Sangita Ratnakara, Swaramela Kalanidhi, Chaturdandi Prakasika, Sangita Sampradaya Pradarshini, Chilappadhikaram.

nodes.title: Life and contribution of the following Musicians of Karnatak Music:
nodes.body: Tyagaraja, Muthuswamy Dikshitar, Shyama Shastri Annamacharya, Kshetrajna, Narayanatirthar, Patnam SubramanyaIyer, Poochi Srinivasa Iyengar, Arunachala Kavirayar, Gopala Krishna Bharati, Jayadeva, Purandara Dasa, Annamacharya, Bhadrachala Ramadasa, NarayanaTirtha, Swati Thirunal, Paidala Gurumurty Shastri, Pachimirium Adiyappaiah, Arunachala Kavirayar, Mahavaidyanatha Iyer, Malaikkottai Govindaswamy Pillai, Tirukkodi Kaval Krishna Iyer, Mysore Doraiswamy Iyengar, S. Balachander, Gopala Naik, Vina Dhanamal, Mysore Vasudevachar, Karaikkudi Sambasiva Iyer, Vina Kuppayar, Chengalvaraya Sastri, Kavi Kunjarabharati, Ghanam Krishna Iyer, Subbaraya Shastri, Papanasam Sivan, Parur Sundaram Iyer, Mysore Chowdiah, Emani Shankar Shastri, Atoor Krishna Pisharoti, Tirupathy Narayana Swamy, Pattabhiramayya, Mysore Sadasiva Rao.

nodes.title: Life and contribution of the following Musicians of Hindustani Music:
nodes.body: Swami Haridas, Tansen, Amir Khusrau, Bhatkhande, Vishnu Digambar Paluskar.
